title.text: Training: learn Voice Verses on the real screens

how.text:
How it fits together

• Every lesson runs on the real screens, in practice mode: nothing reaches the projector, stream or ProPresenter.

• Show me: a spotlight and a pointer do each step while you watch. Let me try: you do it, it waits, and checks the result.

• Set up your booth is the first lesson: Voice Verses finds your sound, screens and ProPresenter, and you confirm each.

• ProPresenter steps happen in ProPresenter, so they are pictured beside Voice Verses, and Voice Verses checks each through ProPresenter's network connection.

• "Show me" buttons on Settings pages and warnings open the right lesson at the right step.
